They show early settlers coming to Tatooine and using big machines to suck all the water wells dry.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] to [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]]|<ref name="LCOT">{{StoryCite|story=The Lost City of Tatooine|book=Wikipedia:Dig_(magazine)|bformatted=''Archaeology's Dig'' July 1999}}</ref>}}
The '''Ghorfa petroglyphs''' were a form of [[Writing/Legends|writing system]] used by the ancient [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Ghorfas]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] up until [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]], when [[Human/Legends|Human]] colonists caused their culture to wither away.

==Overview==
This writing system consisted of elaborated pictures and seemed to have been [[Wikipedia:Logogram|logographic]] in nature. When the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Ghorfas]] evolved into the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]], their complex pictural writing devolved into a series of crude symbols.<ref name="LCOT" /> Eventually, the Sand People came to rely exclusively on oral history.<ref name="DKSBR">[[Darksaber (novel)|''Darksaber'']]</ref>

==History==
When a young [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and his friend [[Biggs Darklighter/Legends|Biggs Darklighter]] set off on an archeological adventure and discovered the [[lost city of the Ghorfas]], they came across tombs that were engraved with such writing. Several of these tombs allowed them to understand a very clear story of the Ghorfa civilization's decline.<ref name="LCOT" /> With proper translation, those glyphs would mean : "With thunder, the spaceship came to the land. We came to our well and the water was gone. And so he died of thirst. May his spirit watch us so that someday, there will be death to the spaceship that steals life, and there will be water in abundance, and we will have our revenge."<ref name="SW Dig BTDS">{{WebCite|url=http://www.christrevas.com/starwars/swdigbts.html|text=Star Wars Dig BTS|archivedate=20100507020921}}</ref>
